_doc: Grey granite massif pieces (grass and jungle ranges) for the adventure map: multi-cell ridges and massifs whose rock fills the footprint edge to edge, snowless rounded pieces and rocky foothills for range edges, and a mine. Canvas = footprint (cols x 80 by rows x 80) plus a band above it (48 px tall, 24 px low); rock seated with its foot a few px above the canvas bottom. Palette of the imported (code-restyled) Pulp Wars pieces: lit rock #a8a69c, shade #5d5f6b, outline #4e4446, snow #f2efe4. Layers: style, camera, light, class-massif, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. See docs/art/MASSIF_ART.md.

styleImported.usage: copy the palette, outline, shading and pixel size only; not the shape

recipes.subject: Subject: a broad heavy mountain massif, one continuous mass of grey granite that fills the whole width of the image from the left edge to the right edge: two summits of different heights joined by a high rocky shoulder and a saddle, broad slopes stepping down in ledges and buttresses to a ragged foot of boulders along the bottom; the summits stay well below the top edge with empty space above them. Colours: lit rock warm light grey #a8a69c, shaded faces cool slate grey #5d5f6b, outline dark slate #4e4446, a small cap of cream snow #f2efe4 only on the highest summit. Wide, solid and lumpy like a big loaf of rock, not a group of separate pointed cones.
